svg.title: S16-android-1280-en--large-type--default--scoped
svg.text: This deletes the copies on this device and affects 2 frames.
Files at the source are not deleted.
Static design; values illustrative. Android PNG: local font approximation, not native rendering.
1.6× finite design sample; NOT the OS maximum accessibility size.
